findings.issue: Secret-read-site scan covers only crates/*/src/** (misses tests/benches/examples/build.rs, crate-level #![expect], per-crate [lints] overrides); no sprint states every crate has [lints] workspace = true (none do today, so workspace clippy lints do not reach crates); the scan is a cross-crate proof living inside the published sc-agent-http crate.
findings.recommendation: Move to crates/workspace-tests/tests/secret_read_site.rs scanning crates/**/*.rs for disallowed_methods allow/expect and as_str on ResolvedApiKey outside sc-agent-http/src/ureq.rs; assert every crates/*/Cargo.toml has [lints] workspace = true and no override; add [lints] workspace = true to r-3 (existing) and r-3b (new crates) Cargo.toml deliverables; update phase acceptance command.

findings.issue: (a) workspace-tests manifest declares allowed_dependencies=[] relying on dev-deps, while four crates add workspace-tests to allowed_dependents; sc-boundary's treatment of dev-only workspace edges is undocumented — either SCB-DEPENDENCY-004 (stale permissions) or -001 (empty allowed list) fails in r-3b. (b) sc-agent-http dev-dep of workspace-tests has no using target. (c) cargo-tree gate rows run only --no-default-features so default-on features pulling forbidden crates pass; sc-observability-types ownership record left with stale compose owner.
findings.recommendation: (a) r-3b first step: lint spike on a dev-only workspace edge, record in boundaries/README.md, write manifest + dependents to match (or police dev set with cargo tree -e dev). (b) drop the dev-dep/permission or name the target. (c) run each gate row twice (default and --no-default-features) except lib-only rows; delete the sc-observability-types record + root dep in r-3.

findings.issue: Collapse into sc_agent_types::git is planned (closed) but `git` is default-on, so sc-jev, sc-jev-backends, sc-agent-secrets, sc-ai, sc-jev-py link process-spawning code they never use; std-only so cargo-tree gate cannot see it; becomes semver surface of the most-depended crate; no guard against a fifth copy.
findings.recommendation: Make `git` non-default (default = [judge, secret, obs]); sc-jev-check enables it; sc-treesitter cli feature enables sc-agent-types/git; add test_git_spawn_only_in_types_git source scan to workspace-tests (allowlist command-extractor user argv spawns); isolated `cargo build -p <lib>` in CI since feature-unified workspace builds hide seams.

findings.issue: sc-agent-http enables judge only for CancelToken (pulls judge/payload with sha2/uuid); r-1 manifest edit list omits removing sc-observability-types from agent-types.toml; sc-agent-http allowed_dependencies closed list may need rand/url for jitter/Endpoint.
findings.recommendation: CancelToken always-on or own `cancel` feature; sc-agent-http features=[secret]; add -sc-observability-types to r-1 manifest edits; state jitter/URL source (prefer std jitter + ureq's http types).
